amendments.body: Restore a compatibility migration for missing `animal.reserve_g` in schema-3 saves. `migrate_v3_to_v4` is now a no-op (`crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:323-329`), so legacy colonies load with `reserve_g = 0`. That breaks save-upgrade continuity because hatching and juvenile maturation now hard-require reserve (`crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:461-468`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:646-651`); a v3 save with berried females or near-mature juveniles will stall or fail immediately after upgrade until the colony re-feeds. The changed expectation in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:274-320` is codifying that regression. Reconstruct reserve from legacy shrimp state, or at least seed enough reserve to honor already-serialized egg/maturation commitments.
amendments.rationale: Schema migration should preserve playable state across upgrades. Defaulting the newly introduced reserve pool to zero drops latent biomass commitments from older saves and changes colony behavior after load.

payload.summary: Reviewed the diff end-to-end in the changed implementation files and ran `cargo test`. I found one backward-compatibility issue in the schema 3→4 save migration; the source-water carbonate validation changes and added coverage otherwise look sound.
